title: 第6章 坑你没商量

content_zh:
娇嫩的耳垂上吊有着绿色的玉坠，微微摇动间，发出清脆的玉响，突兀的现出一抹娇贵…
林锋看上去就如同一个纯朴的少年，被少女艳光所夺，自惭形愧，微微低下头。
其实他只是不想让人看见自己两只眼睛都在发亮。
退婚啊退婚，这可是传说中造就无数逆天强者的退婚啊！
少女身旁，是一个跟她同样一身白袍打扮的青年，身材英挺，面目俊朗，周身上下流转的法力波动，显示他拥有练气十层的实力。
白袍青年扫了林锋一眼，便不再看他，视线投向被林锋用北极天磁剑击碎的山岩，眉头蹙起：“怎么已经是尽快赶过来了，按理说对方应该来不及走才对。”
少女摇摇头：“走了就走了吧。”
白袍青年突然用法力包裹住了声音，传音给少女：“嫣然师妹，传说中那萧焱也是个修道天才，只是后来不知什么原因陨落了，现在变成个废柴？”
慕容嫣然有些不满，双眉微微蹙起：“有外人在场，不谈这个了。”
白袍青年微微一笑：“一个乡下小子罢了，我用法力传音，他怎么可能听到？”
林锋一动不动站在原地，眨了眨眼睛，他还没来得及换那身道袍行头，仍然穿着一身粗布衣裳，看起来确实跟山民一样。
慕容嫣然闻言摇了摇头：“不管他是天才还是废柴，我都要去退了这门婚事，就算是爷爷，也不能强迫我嫁给一个从没见过的人。”
林锋神情越发憨厚纯朴，心里却已经乐开了花：“妹子，给力啊！就是这样，不为外界动摇，坚定不移的去退婚，哥看好你！”
曾经天才，现在废柴，还有未婚妻上门退婚打脸……尼玛，这绝逼是玄幻主角真命天子级别的待遇啊。
林锋现在真恨不得立刻去找那个萧焱，他算是琢磨过味来了，系统对于弟子的要求高的离谱，恐怕只有那些传说中的真命天子，小说主角级别的人物才能看得上眼。
虽然暂时无法证实，但从小不点那里来推断，林锋有八成把握，那个萧焱应该符合系统认可的弟子标准。
“等等，这种主角级别的逆天小牛……”
林锋突然想到，随着慕容嫣然上门退婚，那个现在似乎倒霉到家的萧焱，在退婚之后貌似就应该爆发了。
虽然不知道他是随身带着老爷爷，还是出门捡到超神器，又或者从父母遗物家里破书中翻出超级功法……
总之，只等慕容嫣然上门把婚一退，萧焱斗志一激发，然后就该咸鱼翻身了。

金鳞岂是池中物，一遇风云便化龙。
只需要一个小小的契机，让萧焱上了正轨，用句老话就是命运的车轮开始转动了，那这小子立刻就会牛气的一发不可收拾。
林锋没打算改变萧焱牛弊起来的最终结果，只是想改变一下这货牛弊起来的过程，让自己成为促使萧焱金鳞化龙的那番风云。
换言之，去给萧焱当老爷爷。
可是眼下小不点的事情还没有解决呢，林锋脱不开身。
要是现在由着慕容嫣然上门去退婚，结果让萧焱把别的老爷爷召唤出来，那不就没我什么事了吗？
这婚是一定要退的，但绝不能是现在。
想到这里，林锋心中一动，脸上自然而然浮现出温暖如阳光般的笑容。
白袍青年微笑道：“找不到刚才法力波动的源泉，就算了吧，我们还是尽快赶往乌州城萧家，乌州距离这里还有一段路程呢。”
一直没有说话的白袍老者这是开口说道：“嫣然你天赋出众，前途不可限量，是我流光剑宗的核心弟子，不能耽误在凡人身上，但上门退婚，毕竟是失礼的事情，记得给那萧焱一些补偿。”
慕容嫣然和白袍青年都点头称是：“谨遵叶长老教诲。”
白袍老者叶葛满意点头，就准备带上两个晚辈上路，从始至终都把林锋当成了空气。
在系统作用下，就算是筑基期的叶葛也没有看出林锋有道法修为在身。
林锋这时突然主动凑了上来，有些畏惧的看着三人：“三……三位高人，可是传说中的剑仙？”表情中恰到好处的七分钦羡仰慕，三分畏惧怯懦。
慕容嫣然微微蹙眉，没有搭话。
白袍青年脸上露出骄矜之色，淡淡点头：“你有何事？”
林锋脸上露出大喜之色，连忙说道：“小人住的村子里，出了妖怪，还请仙长出手除去，我们全村人都感激不尽，还请仙长救救我们！”

content_en:
There is a green jade pendant hanging from the delicate earlobe. When it is shaken slightly, it makes a crisp jade sound, and a touch of delicacy suddenly appears...
Lin Feng looked like a simple boy who was robbed by the girl's lustful light. He was ashamed and lowered his head slightly.
In fact, he just didn't want people to see his eyes shining.
Break off the engagement, break off the engagement, this is the legendary break-up that has created countless powerful men!
Next to the girl is a young man dressed in white robes like her. He has a handsome figure and a handsome face. The mana fluctuations flowing around his body show that he has the strength of the tenth level of Qi training.
The white-robed young man glanced at Lin Feng and stopped looking at him. He turned his gaze to the rock that was shattered by Lin Feng's Arctic Sky Magnetic Sword. He frowned: "Why did you rush here as soon as possible? Logically speaking, the other party should not have time to leave."
The girl shook her head: "Just leave."
The young man in white robe suddenly wrapped his voice with magic power and transmitted the message to the girl: "Junior sister Yanran, according to legend, Xiao Yan was also a monastic genius, but he died for unknown reasons and is now a loser?"
Murong Yanran was a little dissatisfied and frowned slightly: "There are outsiders present, so let's not talk about this."
The young man in white robe smiled slightly: "He's just a country boy. How can he hear me when I use magic to transmit my voice?"
Lin Feng stood motionless and blinked. He hadn't had time to change into his Taoist robes, and was still wearing coarse clothes. He looked like a mountain man.
Murong Yanran shook her head when she heard this: "Whether he is a genius or a loser, I have to cancel this marriage. Even grandpa cannot force me to marry someone I have never met."
Lin Feng's expression became more honest and simple, but he was already happy in his heart: "Sister, work hard! That's it, don't be swayed by the outside world, and unswervingly break off the engagement, I am optimistic about you!"
He was once a genius, now a loser, and his fiancée came to break off the engagement and slap him in the face... Damn, this is definitely the treatment of a fantasy protagonist who is destined to be the right one.
Lin Feng really wanted to go find that Xiao Yan right now. He had finally figured it out. The system's requirements for disciples were ridiculously high. I'm afraid only the legendary Mr. Right and the protagonists of novels could be interested in him.
Although it cannot be confirmed for the time being, Lin Feng is 80% sure from the inference from Xiao Budian that Xiao Yan should meet the standards of a disciple recognized by the system.
"Wait a minute, this kind of protagonist-level calf..."
Lin Feng suddenly thought that as Murong Yanran came to break off the engagement, Xiao Yan, who seemed to be unlucky now, seemed to have exploded after breaking off the engagement.
Although I don’t know whether he took his grandfather with him, went out and picked up a super artifact, or dug out a super skill from a torn book left by his parents at home...
In short, all he had to do was wait for Murong Yanran to come and call off the engagement, and Xiao Yan's fighting spirit would be stimulated, and then it would be time for him to make a comeback.
Are the golden scales just a thing in the pond? They turn into dragons when encountering wind and clouds.
All it takes is a small opportunity to put Xiao Yan on the right track. As the old saying goes, the wheel of fate begins to turn, and this kid will immediately become arrogant and out of control.
Lin Feng didn't intend to change the final result of Xiao Yan's cheating, he just wanted to change the process of his cheating, so that he could be the one who caused Xiao Yan's golden scales to transform into a dragon.
In other words, go and be Xiao Yan’s grandfather.
But the little one's matter hasn't been resolved yet, and Lin Feng can't get away.
If now Murong Yanran comes to break off the engagement, and Xiao Yan summons the other old man, wouldn't it mean nothing to me?
This marriage must be called off, but not now.
Thinking of this, Lin Feng's heart moved, and a smile as warm as the sun naturally appeared on his face.
The white-robed young man smiled and said: "If we can't find the source of the mana fluctuation just now, forget it. We should rush to the Xiao family in Wuzhou City as soon as possible. Wuzhou is still some distance away from here.Woolen cloth. "
The white-robed old man who had been silent until now said, "Yanran, you are extremely talented and have an unlimited future. You are the core disciple of my Liuguang Sword Sect. You cannot waste time on a mortal. However, it is rude to come to break off the engagement. Remember to give Xiao Yan some compensation." "
Murong Yanran and the young man in white robe both nodded and said yes: "I sincerely follow Elder Ye's teachings. "
The white-robed old man Ye Ge nodded with satisfaction and prepared to take the two juniors on the road. From the beginning to the end, he treated Lin Feng as nothing.
Under the influence of the system, even Ye Ge, who was in the foundation building stage, did not see that Lin Feng had any Taoist cultivation.
Lin Feng suddenly came forward and looked at the three of them with some fear: "Three...three masters, are they the legendary swordsmen? "The expression on his face was just right: seven points of admiration and three points of fear and cowardice.
Murong Yanran frowned slightly and said nothing.
The young man in white robe showed pride on his face and nodded lightly: "What do you want? "
Lin Feng's face showed a look of joy, and he said quickly: "There is a monster in the village where the villain lives, and we asked the immortal to remove it. Our whole village is grateful, and we also asked the immortal to save us! "
